name: RWT privileged sell reserve burn
summary: RWT's trading contract, which holds RWT's burn role and is the only whitelisted route while public trading is off, exposes sell() to anyone; each sell burns RWT from the RWT/USDT pair and syncs. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought RWT, and called sell repeatedly, each burn raising the price its next sell received, draining the pair's USDT.
notes: Reset is the owner's switch of the sell contract's staking-pool pointer (slot 6) to 0xc1ba5191. On a fork of the block before the exploit with the previous pool 0x214f9887 restored, the attacker's transaction reverts inside sell() ('Not depositor'); no sell() call succeeded before the switch.
The sell contract is unverified; its behaviour is read from the exploit trace. Its RWT burn role and whitelist were granted shortly after deployment, earlier than the reset.
Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion at par; the fee and staking shares the protocol's own addresses received are not netted.
